sections.title: Plane Figures and Polygons
sections.notation: n: number of sides; s: side length; P: perimeter; A: area; r_a: apothem; N_d: diagonal count; S: interior-angle sum; q: similarity scale factor.

sections.title: Triangles
sections.notation: a,b,c: sides opposite A,B,C; K: area; s_p: semiperimeter; h_c,m_c,ℓ_c: altitude, median, internal bisector to side c; q: equilateral side.

sections.title: Quadrilaterals
sections.notation: a,b: adjacent parallelogram sides; θ: included side angle; φ: angle between diagonals; d₁,d₂: full diagonals; L,W: rectangle dimensions; q: square/rhombus side; s_p: semiperimeter.

sections.title: Cartesian Coordinates
sections.notation: (x₁,y₁),(x₂,y₂): endpoints; m:n: division ratio; t: directed interpolation parameter; A: area in the coordinate-area formulas. A and B in Q=A+t(B−A) denote points.

sections.title: Lines
sections.notation: m: slope; (x₁,y₁): known point; A,B,C: line coefficients; a_x,b_y: nonzero intercepts; u,v: direction or vertex vectors as specified.

sections.title: Conics and Circles
sections.notation: (h,k): circle center; r: radius; D,E,F: normalized general-circle coefficients; e: eccentricity; f: focus coordinate in the special focus/directrix constructions.

sections.title: Parabolas
sections.notation: (h,k): vertex; p: signed vertex-to-focus displacement, p≠0. Vertical and horizontal formulas have different axis and directrix equations.

sections.title: Ellipses
sections.notation: (h,k): center; a: semimajor axis; b: semiminor axis; c: center-to-focus distance; e: eccentricity. Use a>b>0 for the noncircular cases.

sections.title: Hyperbolas
sections.notation: (h,k): center; a: center-to-vertex distance; b: conjugate semiaxis; c: center-to-focus distance; e: eccentricity. a,b>0, without an a>b requirement.

sections.title: Prisms
sections.notation: B: one base area; P_b: base perimeter; h: perpendicular base-plane separation; b₀,h_t: triangular-end base/altitude; u,v,w: triangular-end sides; L: perpendicular prism length.

sections.title: Parallelepipeds and Cubes
sections.notation: q: cube edge; L,W,H: cuboid edge lengths; B: selected base area; h: its perpendicular height. Vector u,v,w occur only in the optional extension.

sections.title: Cylinders
sections.notation: r: circular radius or pipe inner radius; R: pipe outer radius; d: diameter; h: perpendicular height/pipe length; a,b: ellipse semiaxes; C_e: ellipse perimeter.

sections.title: Pyramids
sections.notation: B,P_b: base area/perimeter; h: altitude; ℓ: face slant height; E: lateral edge; s: base side; r_a: base apothem; R_b: base circumradius.

sections.title: Cones
sections.notation: r: base radius; h: perpendicular height; ℓ: slant height; q: cube edge only in the specified inscribed-cone preset.

sections.title: Spheres and Spherical Segments
sections.notation: R: sphere radius; D: sphere diameter; h: zone/cap/segment height; r,r₁,r₂: cut-circle radii; R_o,R_i: outer/inner hemispherical shell radii.
